description: Our monthly fee for Cable Billing. Your data is never deleted.

explain.grace: Pay by {date}. After that you can only look and collect money.
explain.read_only: You can look and collect money. Pay to make bills and changes again.
explain.cancelled: Autopay was stopped. You can look and collect money. Pay to start again.
explain.none: Your account is not set up right. Please call support.

autopay.on: Autopay is on. Razorpay takes {total} every month by itself.
autopay.on_first: Autopay is on. The first payment is on {date}.
autopay.not_finished: The last payment was not finished. You can try again.
autopay.failing: This month's autopay payment has not reached us. Please pay again.

pay_how: UPI Autopay or card. You allow it once; then it pays every month by itself.
pay_first_later: Nothing is taken today. The first payment is on {date}.
not_set_up: Online payment is not set up yet. Please call support.

result.waiting: Razorpay has not confirmed the payment yet. This page will show it soon.
result.autopay_on: Autopay is already on. Nothing to pay now.

error.provider: Razorpay is not answering. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.plan_mismatch: Online payment is not set up right. Please call support.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

missed.title: Missed bill runs
missed.body: These months got no bills while the app was view only: {months}. Check them and make them by hand.

banner.trial_ending: Free trial ends on {date}. Pay to keep using the app.

trial_ending.subject: Your Cable Billing free trial ends on {date}
trial_ending.body: Your free trial of Cable Billing ends on {date}. To keep using the app, pay {total} a month (UPI Autopay or card).

grace_started.subject: Please pay for Cable Billing by {date}
grace_started.body: We have not received the payment for Cable Billing. The app works fully till {date}. After that you can only look and collect money until you pay.

grace_ending.subject: Cable Billing will be view only after {date}
grace_ending.body: We have not received the payment for Cable Billing yet. After {date} you can only look and collect money. Pay {total} a month to keep making bills.

reactivated.subject: Cable Billing is working again
reactivated.body: Thank you, we received your payment. The app works fully again, paid till {date}.
reactivated.missed: These months got no bills while the app was view only: {months}. Open Bills to check them and make them by hand.
